commitments.detail: Email collection must be disabled in launch settings before the survey goes live.
All existing test responses must be deleted before any student data are gathered.
Explicit written consent is required due to sensitive questions about mental-health treatment and immigration status.
Research responses must be stored in encrypted institutional storage.
Research responses must be deleted exactly 30 days after collection closes.
The study is capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents.
Presentation is permitted only at the closed university undergraduate symposium, not at any public presentation.
